Track names on or off.

- Music (VLM) shows the track and artist in the bottom-right corner. Choose Off, When the track changes (6 seconds, the default) or Always: in Settings, in the menu (Select + Start), or by clicking either stick (L3 / R3) while the music plays.
- For your own files, the name and artist now come from the file's tags, falling back to the file name.
- For Spotify and other apps: Android only shares what's playing if you give NUONDroid notification access. Settings > Track names from Spotify > Allow, then turn NUONDroid on. It reads no notifications, just the track info.
- When casting with TV only, the track name shows on the TV.
